Example Widgets are small hinged boxes used in the synthetic examples of this plugin.  

# Widget care guide

A widget hinge is the pivot that joins the lid to the base. See the [durability report](https://example.com/reports/durability "Durability") and the [care checklist][care].

Setext lines are not headings
=============================

#hashtag lines are not headings either.

## Cleaning

1. Open the lid fully.
2. Wipe the pin with a dry cloth.
